submission.text: Hi, I was charged twice for my Pro subscription on September 25th - two charges of $49 each. I only have one account. Can you please refund the extra charge? Thanks.

rationale: The feedback states 'charged twice for my Pro subscription' and requests a refund for the 'extra charge,' indicating a billing issue with significant impact that needs same-day action.

guideline.title: Handling Billing Issues
steps: Verify the charge(s) against the customer's order history.
For duplicate or erroneous charges, issue a refund per POL-REFUND-001; no approval needed unless above 500 USD.
For pricing disputes, explain the price change and reference the plan terms; offer a callback if unresolved.
Confirm the refund amount and expected processing time (5-10 business days) to the customer.

policies.title: Refund Policy
policies.text: Customers may request a full refund within 14 days of a charge. Duplicate or erroneous charges are refunded in full regardless of the 14-day window. After 14 days, subscription refunds are pro-rated for the unused portion of the billing period. Enterprise refunds follow the customer's contract terms. Any single refund above 500 USD requires approval from a Billing Manager before it is issued.
